description.value:
You learn to bank the Force energy you disrupt for later use. You can hold a number of power surges equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum 1). You gain one power surge whenever you successfully shut down a force power (such as with force suppression or sever force), or whenever your Force Shield or Force Deflection features let you avoid an attack or succeed on a save.

Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature or object with a force power, you can spend a power surge to add extra damage of that power's type equal to half your consular level.

Finishing a long rest resets your power surges to one, and finishing a short rest while you have none grants you one.
